expressionInfo.title: Results
expressionInfo.expression:
var jurisdictionname = $feature.jurisdictionname; var contest = $feature.contest; var results = OrderBy(Filter(FeatureSetByName($map,"Election Results", ["candidate", "numvotes"], false), "contest = @contest AND jurisdictionname = @jurisdictionname"), 'numvotes DES'); var totalvotes = Sum(results, "numvotes") var html = ` ` for (var i in results) { var percent = Round((i.numvotes / totalvotes) * 100, 2); html += ` ` } html += `
Candidate Votes Percent
${i.candidate} ${i.numvotes} ${percent}%
` return { type : 'text', text : html }
